name: Hail of Thorns

source.note: Not in the free 2024 Basic Rules; written from knowledge of the 2024 PHB and cross-checked against aidedd.org's 2024 entry. Level, school, classes, casting time, range, components, duration and Concentration match the D&D Beyond 2024 spell list.

casting_time.trigger: Taken immediately after you hit a creature with a Ranged weapon.

targets.description: the creature you just hit; each creature within 5 feet of it also saves

summary: Right after a ranged weapon hit: the target and creatures within 5 ft make a Dex save, 1d10 Piercing, half on a success.
text: Bonus Action, cast right after you hit a creature with a Ranged weapon. Your shot bursts into a spray of thorns: the target and every creature within 5 feet of it make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 1d10 Piercing damage on a failure or half as much on a success. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 1.
